BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Arachnidemon!!
So this is the Wind Ark...wow...\nBut it's half sunken!\nWhat do we do now?
There is a need to check if the ark can be\nlifted...
Geez!! We can't let our guard down!\nThis thing seems quite powerful!!
Oh no! The spirits that are gathering here are\nturning more and more evil!!
Uh, what's exactly happening...
Hello, it's good to see you.\nLooks like you made it!
Yo, long time no see! You left the good part for\nus to watch, thanks!!
I-I can more or less tell why you are happy to\nmeet them again...But, who are they?
What? You don't know us?!\nThis lady over here is no ordinary lady, you know!
She is the vice-god of the Dark Realm that\nassists the Goddess of Darkness, Dunkelis. She is\nGrecia, the Goddess of Courage!!
And I'm Burnos, the Dark Captain of Fire, who is\nalso the most important man to Halios, the Dark\nCommander. Keep that in mind!!
Oh my goshhh!!
Oh my gosh! Why are you saying it first!!
Oh my gosh! Why are you saying it first!!\nYou were already great in Eldenbaum, now you even\nget help from the Dark Realm.
Hey, what did you actually do there that makes\nthem come to help?!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore here a little longer.
...Yes, I sensed something unusual. The spirits\nin Calle Mort that are unable to go to the\nDark Realm are turning evil and running riot...
Dunkelis is trying to contact the other gods.\nMeanwhile Vatendeth and Halios are busy\nsupervising the restoration of the Dark Realm...
So Grecia and I came to solve the problem here.
The spirits that have turned evil need to be\npurified and sent to the Dark Realm. Burnos can\npurify spirits with flames, I'm glad he's here...
P-please stop, you're making me blush!
Since Grecia has come to this world, let's get\nher to persuade the Injes that are occupying Calle\nMort!
...I see, so the Injes...they felt my energy when\nI helped you in Lunagent.
They are indeed getting in the way of the spirits\nthat are going to the Dark Realm. I would persuade\nthem to leave, but...
The evil spirits in Calle Mort should be purified\nfirst. I'm sorry but, could you please help Burnos\nto purify them?
I-I-I-I'll pass...\nI-I-I-I'm totally no good when it comes to\ng-g-g-ghosts or e-e-e-evil spirits...
She passes out as soon as she sees a ghost.\nAmazing, isn't it?
Shut up! I'm not proud of it!!
But why are you scared, munchkin?\nYou'll also turn into a ghost when you die.
S-s-stop asking me why!\nI'm not a ghost yet now, so of course I'm scared!
Well, there's nothing we can do about it if\nyou're really scared.
Nobody asked your opinion!
Ha-ha! Fine then.\nI won't insist...
M-may we also help to purify the evil spirits?!\nWe may not be as helpful as the adventurer, but\nwe'd love to help...
As soon as you sense danger, you will retreat\nfrom the battle without hesitation...\nCan you promise that?
Y, yes ma'am!!
Aight!\nOff we go to Calle Mort then!!\nCome with us, munchkin!
When we get there, just wait somewhere that is\nnot too far away until we finish the battle.\nJust don't scamper around, okay?
Alright, alright.\nI'll just stay in the same spot!
It's okay, I'll be there if you pass out!
Tchah! Can you just shut up?!
Hee hee...Well, let's go...
Oh, Reliza, where have you been?\nGrecia and the others have left, you know?
I feel bad for not being able to greet them...\nActually, I was trying to lift the ark with magic\nwhile keeping it away from danger...
Even with magic, I think it's impossible to do it\nalone. But getting the Injes to gather people to\nhelp seems to take some time too...
Aye! Lemme try!!
Whoaaaat?!
Wow, you did it in a wink...what in the world...
Aye! What in the world am I? Hee hee hee ♪
